text:
1. Locate the blue square with a white arrow — this is the **snake head**.
2. Note the direction shown by the white arrow on the blue head (e.g., left, right, up, down).
3. Find the red circular object — this is the **food**.
4. Trace connected green segments attached to the head; these form the **body**, fading in brightness toward the tail.
5. Identify the pointed tip of the final green segment — this is the **tail**.
6. Assign grid coordinates: rows 1–10 from top to bottom, columns 1–10
